title: Figure 18: Layout of proposed undulator-based ILC positron source (KEK)
description: Color schematic titled "Layout of ILC Positron Source" showing a beamline loop with 150 GeV and 250 GeV sections, "Helical Undulator In By-Pass Line," "Photon Collimators," "Photon Target," "Adiabatic Matching Device," e- and e+ damping rings (DR), e- dump, photon dump, auxiliary e- source, e+ pre-accelerator (~5GeV), and interaction point (IP); credited "M. Kuriki, KEK." Caption: "Figure 18. Proposed Undulator-Based Positron Source for the International Linear Collider (courtesy KEK, Japan)." Text above discusses positron production methods.
